description: A dark oil painting of a technician seated at a CRT console showing a bright brain cross-section, while a patient lies on a table with their head inside a large boxy scanner with a glowing ring opening. Racks of dials and cables fill the room. A small plate on top of the scanner reads 'EMI'. No frame or border, nothing graphic.
reason: The scanner housing has a painted plate reading 'EMI'. Remove the lettering so the machine is unmarked.
